description: Checks whether payout-related identifiers (commission, payout, affiliate rate) appear in the source of a ranking/recommendation engine. Only `static-imports` mode is available: running your ranking function under payout-mutation scenarios (`runtime` mode) is turned off because it runs caller-supplied JavaScript. The server operator can turn it on by setting HONESTY_MCP_ENABLE_CODE_EXEC=1; that runs the code with the server's full filesystem, network and environment access, and the worker thread only bounds time. `static-imports` mode greps source files you supply for any reference to payout-related identifiers, to assert the ranking engine's code never even has payout data in scope. You send the file contents as a map of path -> content; this server does not read paths from disk, and a list of paths is rejected. Matching is whole-word and case-insensitive: the identifier `commission` is NOT matched inside `commissionRate`, `commission_rate`, `affiliateUrl` or `payoutPerClick`, so those names pass as CLEAN. Pass `matchIdentifierParts: true` to also find an identifier as one part of a longer camelCase, snake_case, SCREAMING_CASE or kebab-case name (it still does not match plurals such as `affiliates`, or a word fused into another with no separator, such as `mypayout`). It is a best-effort text/regex grep, not a real parser (it won't catch a dynamically-built import specifier or a re-export under an aliased name). A CLEAN result means no match in the text you sent, not that the engine is payout-neutral in general; re-run this in CI whenever the ranking logic changes.

caseInsensitiveMatch.description: [static-imports mode] Case-insensitive identifier matching. Default true.

anyOf.description: Rejected with an error: this server does not read file paths from disk. Send a map instead.
Map of path -> file content. No filesystem access.

files.description: [static-imports mode, required, at least one file] Source files to scan for payout references, as a map of path -> content. A list of paths is an error. An empty map is a tool error, never a CLEAN result over zero files.

matchIdentifierParts.description: [static-imports mode, payout-invariance-kit 0.3+] Default false (whole-word matching, so `commission` does not match `commissionRate`). When true, an identifier is also found as one part of a longer camelCase, snake_case, SCREAMING_CASE or kebab-case name (`affiliate` finds `affiliateUrl` and `AFFILIATE_URL`), but not plurals or words fused with no separator.

mode.description: Which check to run. Only `static-imports` is available.

payoutIdentifiers.description: [static-imports mode, required, non-empty] Identifiers that must never appear in the ranking engine's source, e.g. "commission", "payout", "affiliateRate". Each is matched as a whole word (`commission` does not match `commissionRate`; see `matchIdentifierParts`). An identifier that is blank (only whitespace or invisible characters) is a tool error.

stripComments.description: [static-imports mode] Strip comments before matching, so a mention in a comment doesn't count. Default true.

name: check_payout_invariance
title: Check whether a ranking engine ignores payout (static-imports only)
